method: Pandoc Markdown AST; word tokens in text, headings, captions and tables using Unicode word groups with internal hyphens/apostrophes. Excludes image alt text, URLs, equations, raw HTML, front matter, references and appendices. Approximate editorial count.
count_note: Image alternative text is excluded explicitly, including implicit-figure captions; earlier approximate counts are not directly comparable. Protected opening text is unchanged. Page counts require compilation and visual review; synchronisation retains the previous recorded page counts.
